module: Onboard camera (cockpit, hood, rider...) defined in the vehicle's jbeam (camera section): attaches to the refNodes.ref node (or camNodeID) with an offset, orients the view according to the reference nodes and lets the head turn (yaw ±, pitch limited to ±85 degrees) if canRotate (true by default). Looking backward (data.lookBack) places the camera at the rear of the bounding box. Includes a manualzoom. Returns a constructor.
notes: The camera name determines the icon: onboard.driver -> personSolid, onboard.hood -> vehicleHood, other -> info. "driver" is hidden but its data remain used by other cameras. rider/onboard.rider enables canUseVehicleTriggerCrosshair.
`self.canRotate = self.canRotate ~= nil and self.canRotate or true` is always true (if canRotate is false, the expression gives true again): bug, canRotate=false from the jbeam is ignored.
If rotation (jbeam) has a zero z, its x,y are added to the current rotation every frame and the ±85 clamp is not applied.

C.desc: Onboard camera. jbeam fields: refNodes{ref,left,back}, offset{x,y,z}, rotation, fov, name, idRef/idUp/idBack, canRotate.

init.desc: Creates the manualzoom, applies the vehicle configuration and resets.

onVehicleCameraConfigChanged.desc: Hook: recomputes hidden, icon and canUseVehicleTriggerCrosshair from the name.

reset.desc: Resets the head rotation to zero and the zoom to default.

update.desc: Places the camera and applies rotation and zoom to data.res.

returns.desc: false if the reference nodes are degenerate, otherwise true
